title: GitHub
description: Repositories, issues and pull requests; open an issue.

fields.name: token
fields.label: Access token
fields.help: A fine-grained personal access token with read access to the repositories (and issues: write, to open issues).

fields.name: owner
fields.label: Owner
fields.help: A user or organisation whose repositories are read first (optional).

setup.title: A token that may read
setup.say: Make a fine-grained token: [GitHub → Settings → Developer settings → Fine-grained tokens](https://github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens/new) — the repositories to read, Contents and Issues: read (Issues: write, to open issues). Give it here.
